source.verification: official configuration objects and active bundled Lua; no game UI lifecycle test

server.name: PVP
server.label: PVP
server.help: 玩家可以攻击或杀害其他玩家
server.helpEn: Players can hurt and kill other players

server.name: PVPLogToolChat
server.label: PVPLogToolChat
server.help: PVP 已记录在管理员聊天日志中
server.helpEn: PVP is logged to admin chat

server.name: PVPLogToolFile
server.label: PVPLogToolFile
server.help: PVP 已记录在服务器日志文件中
server.helpEn: PVP is logged to file

server.name: PauseEmpty
server.label: PauseEmpty
server.help: 服务器没有玩家时, 自动暂停服务器
server.helpEn: Game time stops when there are no players online

server.name: GlobalChat
server.label: GlobalChat
server.help: 打开或关闭全局聊天.
server.helpEn: Toggles global chat on or off.

server.name: Open
server.label: Open
server.help: 玩家可以在白名单中没有帐户的情况下加入. 如果设置为 false, 管理员必须手动创建用户名/密码组合.
server.helpEn: Clients may join without already having an account in the whitelist. If set to false, administrators must manually create username/password combos.

server.name: ServerWelcomeMessage
server.defaultValue: Welcome to Project Zomboid Multiplayer! <LINE> <LINE> To interact with the Chat panel: press Tab, T, or Enter. <LINE> <LINE> The Tab key will change the target stream of the message. <LINE> <LINE> Global Streams: /all <LINE> Local Streams: /say, /yell <LINE> Special Steams: /whisper, /safehouse, /faction. <LINE> <LINE> Press the Up arrow to cycle through your message history. Click the Gear icon to customize chat. <LINE> <LINE> Happy surviving!
server.label: ServerWelcomeMessage
server.help:
在 聊 天 面 板 中 可 见 的 第 一 条 欢 迎 信 息 . 
 这 将 在 玩 家 登 录 后 立 即 显 示 . 
 你 可 以 使 用 RGB 颜 色 来 决 定 欢 迎 信 息 的 颜 色 . 你 也 可 以 使 用 <LINE> 来 在 你 的 文 本 中 新 建 一 行 . 使 用 : <RGB:1,0,0> 这 条 信 息 将 显 示 为 红 色 !
server.helpEn: The first welcome message visible in the chat panel. This will be displayed immediately after player login. you can use RGB colours to chance the colour of the welcome message. You can also use < LINE>, without the space, to create a separate lines within your text. Use: \<RGB:1,0,0> This message will show up red!

server.name: DisplayUserName
server.label: DisplayUserName
server.help: 在玩家头顶显示玩家的ID.
server.helpEn: Display usernames above player's heads in-game.

server.name: ShowFirstAndLastName
server.label: ShowFirstAndLastName
server.help: 在玩家头上显示姓名而不是用户名.
server.helpEn: Display first & last name above player's heads.

server.name: SpawnPoint
server.label: SpawnPoint
server.help: 固定服务器出生点, 0,0,0 为服务器默认设置.
server.helpEn: Force every new player to spawn at these set x,y,z world coordinates. Find desired coordinates at map.projectzomboid.com. (Ignored when 0,0,0)

server.name: SafetySystem
server.label: SafetySystem
server.help: 玩家可以自行开启 PVP 攻击其他玩家. SafetySystem 设置为 false 则随时可以攻击玩家.
server.helpEn: Players can enter and leave PVP on an individual basis. A player can only hurt another player when at least one of them is in PVP mode - as shown by the unobscured skull and crossbones on the left of the screen. When SafetySystem=false, players are free to hurt each other at any time if PVP is enabled.

server.name: ShowSafety
server.label: ShowSafety
server.help: 如果玩家开启了 PVP, 则在玩家头顶显示一个骷髅头图标
server.helpEn: Display a skull icon over the head of players who have entered PVP mode

server.name: SafetyToggleTimer
server.label: SafetyToggleTimer
server.help:
设置开关 PVP 的切换时间
最小值=0 最大值=1000 默认=2
server.helpEn:
The time it takes for a player to enter and leave PVP mode
Min: 0 Max: 1000 Default: 2

server.name: SafetyCooldownTimer
server.label: SafetyCooldownTimer
server.help:
设置再次开/关 PVP 的冷却时间
最小值=0 最大值=1000 默认=3
server.helpEn:
The delay before a player can enter or leave PVP mode again, having recently done so
Min: 0 Max: 1000 Default: 3

server.name: SafetyDisconnectDelay
server.label: SafetyDisconnectDelay
server.help: 最小值=0 最大值=60 默认=60
server.helpEn: Min: 0 Max: 60 Default: 60

server.name: SpawnItems
server.label: SpawnItems
server.help:
给予新玩家物品.
 可使用逗号分隔多个物品.
 例如: Base.Axe, Base.Bag_BigHikingBag
server.helpEn:
Item types new players spawn with.
Separate multiple item types with commas.
Example: Base.Axe,Base.Bag_BigHikingBag

server.name: DefaultPort
server.label: DefaultPort
server.help:
玩家数据的默认起始端口. 如果是 UDP, 这是使用的两个端口之一.
最小值=0 最大值=65535 默认=16261
server.helpEn:
Default starting port for player data. If UDP, this is this one of two ports used.
Min: 0 Max: 65535 Default: 16261

server.name: UDPPort
server.label: UDPPort
server.helpEn: Min: 0 Max: 65535 Default: 16262

server.name: ResetID
server.label: ResetID
server.help: 重启 ID 决定了服务器是否已经进行了软复位. 如果这个数字确实与客户端匹配, 客户端必须创建一个新的角色. 与 玩家服务器ID 一起使用. 强烈建议你把这些ID备份到某个地方
server.helpEn: Reset ID determines if the server has undergone a soft-reset. If this number does match the client, the client must create a new character. Used in conjunction with PlayerServerID. It is strongly advised that you backup these IDs somewhere

server.name: Mods
server.label: Mods
server.help: 在此处输入模组加载 ID. 可在 \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\info.txt 中找到
server.helpEn: Enter the mod loading ID here. It can be found in \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\info.txt

server.name: Map
server.label: Map
server.help: 输入在 \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\media\maps\中找到的模组的文件夹名
server.helpEn: Enter the foldername of the mod found in \Steam\steamapps\workshop\modID\mods\modName\media\maps\

server.name: DoLuaChecksum
server.label: DoLuaChecksum
server.help: 踢出和服务器文件不匹配的玩家.
server.helpEn: Kick clients whose game files don't match the server's.

server.name: Public
server.label: Public
server.help: 在游戏内浏览器中显示服务器. (注意: 启用 Steam 的服务器在 Steam 服务器浏览器中始终可见)
server.helpEn: Shows the server on the in-game browser. (Note: Steam-enabled servers are always visible in the Steam server browser)

server.name: PublicName
server.label: PublicName
server.help: 在游戏内浏览器和Steam浏览器 (如果适用) 中显示的服务器名称
server.helpEn: Name of the server displayed in the in-game browser and, if applicable, the Steam browser

server.name: PublicDescription
server.label: PublicDescription
server.help:
游戏内公共服务器浏览器中显示的描述. 输入 
 将在你的描述中创建一个新行
server.helpEn:
Description displayed in the in-game public server browser. Typing 
 will create a new line in your description

server.name: MaxPlayers
server.label: MaxPlayers
server.help:
设置服务器的人数上限, 不含管理员.
警告: 服务器超过 32 人将可能导致地图传输问题和同步问题, 请谨慎操作.
最小值=1 最大值=254 默认=32
server.helpEn:
Maximum number of players that can be on the server at one time. This excludes admins.
WARNING: Server player counts above 32 will potentially result in poor map streaming and desync. Please advance with caution.
Min: 1 Max: 254 Default: 32

server.name: PingLimit
server.label: PingLimit
server.help:
玩家被踢出服务器之前的 Ping 限制, 以毫秒为单位. (设置为 0 以禁用)
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
server.helpEn:
Ping limit, in milliseconds, before a player is kicked from the server. (Set to 0 to disable)
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

server.name: SafehousePreventsLootRespawn
server.label: SafehousePreventsLootRespawn
server.help: 物品不会在玩家认领为安全屋的建筑物中重新生成
server.helpEn: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have claimed as a safehouse

server.name: DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath
server.label: DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath
server.help: 玩家死亡后自动从服务器的白名单中移除, 防止玩家在死亡后创建新的角色
server.helpEn: Remove player accounts from the whitelist after death. This prevents players creating a new character after death on Open=false servers

server.name: NoFire
server.label: NoFire
server.help: 除篝火外, 所有形式的火源均禁用
server.helpEn: All forms of fire are disabled - except for campfires

server.name: AnnounceDeath
server.label: AnnounceDeath
server.help: 如果选中, 每次玩家死亡时都会在聊天中显示一条全局消息
server.helpEn: If checked, every time a player dies a global message will be displayed in the chat

server.name: AnnounceAnimalDeath
server.label: AnnounceAnimalDeath
server.help: 如果选中, 每次动物死亡时都会在聊天中显示一条全局消息
server.helpEn: If checked, every time an animal dies a global message will be displayed in the chat

server.name: SaveWorldEveryMinutes
server.label: SaveWorldEveryMinutes
server.help:
地图的加载部分在经过设定的现实分钟数后保存. (地图通常仅在客户端离开加载区域后保存)
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
server.helpEn:
Loaded parts of the map are saved after this set number of real-world minutes have passed. (The map is usually saved only after clients leave a loaded area)
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

server.name: PlayerSafehouse
server.label: PlayerSafehouse
server.help: 管理员和玩家都可以申请安全屋
server.helpEn: Both admins and players can claim safehouses

server.name: AdminSafehouse
server.label: AdminSafehouse
server.help: 只有管理员可以申请安全屋
server.helpEn: Only admins can claim safehouses

server.name: SafehouseAllowTrepass
server.label: SafehouseAllowTrepass
server.help: 允许玩家可以随意出入其他玩家的安全屋
server.helpEn: Allow non-members to enter a safehouse without being invited

server.name: SafehouseAllowFire
server.label: SafehouseAllowFire
server.help: 允许火焰破坏安全屋
server.helpEn: Allow fire to damage safehouses

server.name: SafehouseAllowLoot
server.label: SafehouseAllowLoot
server.help: 允许玩家可以拿取其他玩家安全屋内的物品
server.helpEn: Allow non-members to take items from safehouses

server.name: SafehouseAllowRespawn
server.label: SafehouseAllowRespawn
server.help: 设置玩家死亡后是否在已设定的安全屋内重生
server.helpEn: Players will respawn in a safehouse that they were a member of before they died

server.name: SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim
server.label: SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim
server.help:
设置玩家存活几天后才可设置安全屋
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
server.helpEn:
Players must have survived this number of in-game days before they are allowed to claim a safehouse
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

server.name: SafeHouseRemovalTime
server.label: SafeHouseRemovalTime
server.help:
自动移除超过设置时间 (现实世界) 没有上线玩家的安全屋
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=144
server.helpEn:
Players are automatically removed from a safehouse they have not visited for this many real-world hours
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 144

server.name: SafehouseAllowNonResidential
server.label: SafehouseAllowNonResidential
server.help: 管理玩家是否可以占有非住宅建筑.
server.helpEn: Governs whether players can claim non-residential buildings.

server.name: MaxSafezoneSize
server.label: MaxSafezoneSize
server.helpEn: Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 20000

server.name: AllowDestructionBySledgehammer
server.label: AllowDestructionBySledgehammer
server.help: 允许玩家使用大锤摧毁世界物体
server.helpEn: Allow players to destroy world objects with sledgehammers

server.name: SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse
server.label: SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse
server.help: 允许玩家只在他们的安全屋内摧毁世界物体 (要求允许使用大锤破坏).
server.helpEn: Allow players to destroy world objects only in their safehouse (require AllowDestructionBySledgehammer to true).

server.name: WarStartDelay
server.label: WarStartDelay
server.help:
战争开始前的时间 (秒).
最小值=60 最大值=2147483647 默认=600
server.helpEn:
Time in seconds before the war starts.
Min: 60 Max: 2147483647 Default: 600

server.name: WarDuration
server.label: WarDuration
server.help:
战争持续时间 (秒).
最小值=60 最大值=2147483647 默认=3600
server.helpEn:
War duration in seconds.
Min: 60 Max: 2147483647 Default: 3600

server.name: WarSafehouseHitPoints
server.label: WarSafehouseHitPoints
server.help:
安全屋生命值上限.
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=3
server.helpEn:
Safehouse hit points limit.
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 3

server.name: ServerPlayerID
server.label: ServerPlayerID
server.help: 玩家服务器ID 决定一个角色是来自另一个服务器, 还是来自单个玩家, 这个值可能会被软重置改变. 如果这个数字与客户端匹配, 客户端必须创建一个新角色. 这与 重置ID 一起使用. 强烈建议你在某处备份这些 ID
server.helpEn: ServerPlayerID determines if a character is from another server, or single player. This value may be changed by soft resets. If this number does match the client, the client must create a new character. This is used in conjunction with ResetID. It is strongly advised that you backup these IDs somewhere

server.name: RCONPort
server.label: RCONPort
server.help:
RCON (远程控制台) 的端口
最小值=0 最大值=65535 默认=27015
server.helpEn:
The port for the RCON (Remote Console)
Min: 0 Max: 65535 Default: 27015

server.name: RCONPassword
server.label: RCONPassword
server.help: RCON 密码 (请使用高强度密码)
server.helpEn: RCON password (Pick a strong password)

server.name: DiscordEnable
server.label: DiscordEnable
server.help: 整合全局文字聊天与 Discord 频道的聊天
server.helpEn: Enables global text chat integration with a Discord channel

server.name: DiscordToken
server.label: DiscordToken
server.help: Discord 机器人访问令牌
server.helpEn: Discord bot access token

server.name: DiscordChatChannel
server.label: DiscordChatChannel
server.help: Discord 聊天的频道名称
server.helpEn: The Discord chat channel name

server.name: DiscordLogChannel
server.label: DiscordLogChannel
server.help: Discord 日志的频道名称
server.helpEn: The Discord logs channel name

server.name: DiscordCommandChannel
server.label: DiscordCommandChannel
server.help: Discord 命令的频道名称
server.helpEn: The Discord commands channel name

server.name: WebhookAddress
server.label: WebhookAddress
server.help: Slack incoming webhook URL
server.helpEn: The Slack incoming webhook URL

server.name: Password
server.label: Password
server.help: 玩家必须知道密码才能加入服务器. (通过主机按钮托管服务器时忽略)
server.helpEn: Clients must know this password to join the server. (Ignored when hosting a server via the Host button)

server.name: MaxAccountsPerUser
server.label: MaxAccountsPerUser
server.help:
限制单个 Steam 用户的账户数量, 当使用'主机'按钮时被忽略.
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
server.helpEn:
Limits the number of different accounts a single Steam user may create on this server. Ignored when using the Hosts button.
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

server.name: AllowCoop
server.label: AllowCoop
server.help: 允许合作/分屏玩家
server.helpEn: Allow co-op/splitscreen players

server.name: SleepAllowed
server.label: SleepAllowed
server.help: 玩家可以睡觉, 但他们不一定需要睡觉
server.helpEn: Players are allowed to sleep when their survivor becomes tired, but they do not NEED to sleep

server.name: SleepNeeded
server.label: SleepNeeded
server.help: 玩家会有疲劳状态. 如果 SleepAllowed 设置为 false 则禁用
server.helpEn: Players get tired and need to sleep. (Ignored if SleepAllowed=false)

server.name: KnockedDownAllowed
server.label: KnockedDownAllowed
server.help: 试验功能: 启用此设置可能导致玩家位置出现视觉上的不同步.
server.helpEn: WIP: Activating this setting may cause visual desynchronization of player positions.

server.name: WorkshopItems
server.label: WorkshopItems
server.help: 列出供服务器下载的创意工坊模组 ID. 每个必须用分号分隔. 示例: 创意工坊项目=514427485;513111049
server.helpEn: List Workshop Mod IDs for the server to download. Each must be separated by a semicolon. Example: WorkshopItems=514427485;513111049

server.name: SteamScoreboard
server.label: SteamScoreboard
server.help: 在玩家列表中显示 Steam 用户名和头像.
server.helpEn: Show Steam usernames and avatars in the Players list.

server.name: SteamVAC
server.label: SteamVAC
server.help: 启用 Steam VAC 封禁系统
server.helpEn: Enable the Steam VAC system

server.name: UPnP
server.label: UPnP
server.help: 启用 UPnP 网关, 并自动配置端口转发规则. 如果失败, 服务器将退回到默认端口
server.helpEn: Attempt to configure a UPnP-enabled internet gateway to automatically setup port forwarding rules. The server will fall back to default ports if this fails

server.name: VoiceEnable
server.label: VoiceEnable
server.help: 选中后, VOIP 功能被启用
server.helpEn: VOIP is enabled when checked

server.name: VoiceMinDistance
server.label: VoiceMinDistance
server.help:
可以听到 VOIP 声音的最小距离.
最小值=0.00 最大值=100000.00 默认=10.00
server.helpEn:
The minimum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard.
Min: 0.00 Max: 100000.00 Default: 10.00

server.name: VoiceMaxDistance
server.label: VoiceMaxDistance
server.help:
可以听到 VOIP 声音的最大距离.
最小值=0.00 最大值=100000.00 默认=100.00
server.helpEn:
The maximum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard.
Min: 0.00 Max: 100000.00 Default: 100.00

server.name: Voice3D
server.label: Voice3D
server.help: 切换 VOIP 的定向音频效果
server.helpEn: Toggle directional audio for VOIP

server.name: SpeedLimit
server.label: SpeedLimit
server.helpEn: Min: 10.00 Max: 150.00 Default: 70.00

server.name: LoginQueueConnectTimeout
server.label: LoginQueueConnectTimeout
server.help: 最小值=20 最大值=1200 默认=60
server.helpEn: Min: 20 Max: 1200 Default: 60

server.name: server_browser_announced_ip
server.label: server_browser_announced_ip
server.help: 设置广播服务器的 IP. 这适用于具有多个 IP 地址的网络配置, 例如服务器群
server.helpEn: Set the IP from which the server is broadcast. This is for network configurations with multiple IP addresses, such as server farms

server.name: PlayerRespawnWithSelf
server.label: PlayerRespawnWithSelf
server.help: 玩家可以在死亡的位置重生
server.helpEn: Players can respawn in-game at the coordinates where they died

server.name: PlayerRespawnWithOther
server.label: PlayerRespawnWithOther
server.help: 玩家死亡后可以在[分屏]/远程游戏玩家的位置重生
server.helpEn: Players can respawn in-game at a split screen / Remote Play player's location

server.name: FastForwardMultiplier
server.label: FastForwardMultiplier
server.help:
控制玩家睡眠时时间流逝的速度. 该数值将会让睡眠时时间流逝的速度翻倍.
最小值=1.00 最大值=100.00 默认=40.00
server.helpEn:
Governs how fast time passes while players sleep. Value multiplies the speed of the time that passes during sleeping.
Min: 1.00 Max: 100.00 Default: 40.00

server.name: DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected
server.label: DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected
server.help: 会让安全屋表现得像一个普通的房子, 如果这个安全屋的主人之一在线的话
server.helpEn: Safehouse acts like a normal house if an owner of the safehouse is connected (so secure when the owner is offline)

server.name: Faction
server.label: Faction
server.help: 允许玩家创建阵营
server.helpEn: Players can create factions when true

server.name: FactionDaySurvivedToCreate
server.label: FactionDaySurvivedToCreate
server.help:
创建阵营所需的特定生存天数
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
server.helpEn:
Players must survive this number of in-game days before being allowed to create a faction
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

server.name: FactionPlayersRequiredForTag
server.label: FactionPlayersRequiredForTag
server.help:
阵营所有者创建团队标记需要阵营中有多少玩家
最小值=1 最大值=2147483647 默认=1
server.helpEn:
Number of players required as faction members before the faction owner can create a group tag
Min: 1 Max: 2147483647 Default: 1

server.name: DisableRadioStaff
server.label: DisableRadioStaff
server.help: 禁用具有任何访问级别的玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from players with an access level

server.name: DisableRadioAdmin
server.label: DisableRadioAdmin
server.help: 禁用具有[admin]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'admin' access level

server.name: DisableRadioGM
server.label: DisableRadioGM
server.help: 禁用具有[GM]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'gm' access level

server.name: DisableRadioOverseer
server.label: DisableRadioOverseer
server.help: 禁用具有[overseer]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'overseer' access level

server.name: DisableRadioModerator
server.label: DisableRadioModerator
server.help: 禁用具有[moderator]访问级别的玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from players with 'moderator' access level

server.name: DisableRadioInvisible
server.label: DisableRadioInvisible
server.help: 禁用隐形玩家的无线电传输
server.helpEn: Disables radio transmissions from invisible players

server.name: ClientCommandFilter
server.label: ClientCommandFilter
server.help:
不会写入 cmd.txt 服务器日志的以分号分隔的命令列表. 例如: 
-vehicle. 输入 * 表示不写任何车辆命令. 而输入: 
+vehicle.installPart 则会将该命令加入写入的白名单
server.helpEn:
Semicolon-separated list of commands that will not be written to the cmd.txt server log. For example: 
-vehicle. Inputting * means do NOT write any vehicle command. Inputting: 
+vehicle.installPart means DO write that command

server.name: ClientActionLogs
server.label: ClientActionLogs

最小值=0.00 最大值=4.00 默认=0.60
sandbox.helpEn:
Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.
Min: 0.00 Max: 4.00 Default: 0.60

sandbox.name: RollsMultiplier
sandbox.label: 掷骰子倍率 [!]
sandbox.help:
<BHC> [!] 建议不要更改此设置. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>

 可用于调整生成物品时在物品表上进行的掷骰子次数. 不会将掷骰子次数减少到 1 以下. 如果设置为高值, 可能会对性能产生负面影响. 强烈建议不要更改此设置.
最小值=0.10 最大值=100.00 默认=1.00
sandbox.helpEn:
<BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>

 Can be used to adjust the number of rolls made on loot tables when spawning loot. Will not reduce the number of rolls below 1. Can negatively affect performance if set to high values. It is highly recommended that this not be changed.
Min: 0.10 Max: 100.00 Default: 1.00

sandbox.name: LootItemRemovalList
sandbox.label: 物品物品移除列表
sandbox.help: 一个逗号分隔的物品类型列表, 这些物品不会作为普通物品生成.
sandbox.helpEn: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.

sandbox.name: RemoveStoryLoot
sandbox.label: 移除不需要的故事物品
sandbox.help: 如果启用, 物品物品移除列表上的物品, 或者将稀有度设置为'无'的物品, 将不会在随机世界故事中生成.
sandbox.helpEn: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.

sandbox.name: RemoveZombieLoot
sandbox.label: 移除不需要的僵尸物品
sandbox.help: 如果启用, 物品物品移除列表上的物品, 或者将稀有度设置为"无"的物品, 将不会穿戴在僵尸身上, 或附着在僵尸上.
sandbox.helpEn: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.

sandbox.name: ZombiePopLootEffect
sandbox.label: 僵尸数量物品影响
sandbox.help:
如果大于 0, 物品的生成将根据附近僵尸的数量增加, 
效果将乘以这个数字.
最小值=0 最大值=20 默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies, 
with the effect multiplied by this number.
Min: 0 Max: 20 Default: 0

sandbox.name: InsaneLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品极度罕见
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 0.00 Max: 0.20 Default: 0.05

sandbox.name: ExtremeLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品特别稀少
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 0.05 Max: 0.60 Default: 0.20

sandbox.name: RareLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品很少
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 0.20 Max: 1.00 Default: 0.60

sandbox.name: NormalLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品正常
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 0.60 Max: 2.00 Default: 1.00

sandbox.name: CommonLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品常见
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 1.00 Max: 3.00 Default: 2.00

sandbox.name: AbundantLootFactor
sandbox.label: 战利品非常丰富
sandbox.helpEn: Min: 2.00 Max: 4.00 Default: 3.00

sandbox.name: Temperature
sandbox.label: 温度
sandbox.help:
全地图温度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
The global temperature.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: Rain
sandbox.label: 降水量
sandbox.help:
降雨频率.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How often it rains.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: ErosionSpeed
sandbox.label: 侵蚀速度
sandbox.help:
距离侵蚀机制 (在世界添加藤蔓, 长草, 新树等)
达到完全生长还有多少天.
默认=慢 (200 天)
sandbox.helpEn:
Number of days until the erosion system (which adds vines, long grass,
new trees etc. to the world) will reach 100% growth.
Default = Slow (200 Days)

sandbox.name: ErosionDays
sandbox.label: 侵蚀天数
sandbox.help:
侵蚀达到100%的天数.
-1表示不会生长.
0表示使用侵蚀速度的设置.
最大值 36,500 (约100 年).
最小值=-1 最大值=36500 默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
For a custom Erosion Speed. Zero means use the Erosion Speed option.
Maximum is 36,500 days (approximately 100 years).
Min: -1 Max: 36500 Default: 0

sandbox.name: Farming
sandbox.label: 作物生长速率
sandbox.help:
植物生长速度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
The speed of plant growth.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: CompostTime
sandbox.label: 堆肥时间
sandbox.help:
堆肥箱中食物分解的时间.
默认=2 周
sandbox.helpEn:
How long it takes for food to break down in a composter.
Default = 2 Weeks

sandbox.name: StatsDecrease
sandbox.label: 状态减少速度
sandbox.help:
角色的饥饿,口渴和疲劳会以多快的速度减少.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How fast the player's hunger, thirst, and fatigue will decrease.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: NatureAbundance
sandbox.label: 野外资源量
sandbox.help:
影响钓鱼/搜寻的难度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
The abundance of items found in Foraging mode.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: Alarm
sandbox.label: 房屋警报频率
sandbox.help:
玩家在闯入新房子时激活房屋警报的可能性.
默认=偶尔
sandbox.helpEn:
How likely the player is to activate a house alarm when breaking into a new house.
Default = Sometimes

sandbox.name: LockedHouses
sandbox.label: 上锁房屋频率
sandbox.help:
决定房屋门窗上锁几率.
默认=非常频繁
sandbox.helpEn:
How frequently the doors of homes and buildings will be locked when discovered.
Default = Very Often

sandbox.name: StarterKit
sandbox.label: 新手包
sandbox.help: 带着薯片, 水瓶, 书包, 棒球棒和铁锤开局.
sandbox.helpEn: Spawn with Chips, a Water Bottle, a Small Backpack, a Baseball Bat, and a Hammer.

sandbox.name: Nutrition
sandbox.label: 营养
sandbox.help: 食物的营养价值影响玩家的身体状况.
sandbox.helpEn: Nutritional value of food affects the player's condition. Turning this off will stop the player gaining or losing weight.

sandbox.name: FoodRotSpeed
sandbox.label: 食物变质速度
sandbox.help:
决定食物在冰箱里/外有多快会变质.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How fast that food will spoil, inside or outside of a fridge.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: FridgeFactor
sandbox.label: 冷藏效率
sandbox.help:
决定冰箱的效果有多强劲.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How effective a fridge will be at keeping food fresh for longer.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn
sandbox.label: 物品重生阻止时间
sandbox.help:
当 > 0时,物品将不会在此小时内访问过的区域中重新生成.
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

sandbox.name: HoursForLootRespawn
sandbox.label: 物品刷新小时数
sandbox.help:
如果此参数大于 0, 在 X 小时后, 世界上城镇和拖车公园中的所有容器将重新生成物品. 
要生成物品, 容器必须至少被搜刮过一次. 物品刷新不受可见性或后续搜刮的影响.
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
When greater than 0, after X hours, all containers in towns and trailer parks in the world will respawn loot.
To spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 0

sandbox.name: MaxItemsForLootRespawn
sandbox.label: 最大物品刷新数量
sandbox.help:
当容器中的物品数量大于或等于此设置时, 将不会刷新.
最小值=0 最大值=2147483647 默认=5
sandbox.helpEn:
Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.
Min: 0 Max: 2147483647 Default: 5

sandbox.name: ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn
sandbox.label: 玩家建筑阻止物品刷新
sandbox.help: 玩家加固或建造的建筑物中的物品将不会刷新.
sandbox.helpEn: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in.

sandbox.name: WorldItemRemovalList
sandbox.defaultValue: Base.Hat, Base.Glasses, Base.Maggots, Base.Slug, Base.Slug2, Base.Snail, Base.Worm, Base.Dung_Mouse, Base.Dung_Rat
sandbox.label: 世界物品移除列表
sandbox.help: 将在 移除清单的时间 设置的小时后删除. 以逗号分隔的项目类型列表.
sandbox.helpEn: A comma-separated list of item types that will be removed after HoursForWorldItemRemoval hours.

sandbox.name: HoursForWorldItemRemoval
sandbox.label: 移除清单的时间
sandbox.help:
物品掉落在地上的小时数,然后才会被移除.
 物品会在下次加载地图的那个部分时被移除.
 数值 0 意味着物品不会被移除.
最小值=0.00 最大值=2147483647.00 默认=24.00
sandbox.helpEn:
Number of hours since an item was dropped on the ground before it is removed. 
Items are removed the next time that part of the map is loaded.  
Zero means items are not removed.
Min: 0.00 Max: 2147483647.00 Default: 24.00

sandbox.name: ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle
sandbox.label: 移除列表为白名单
sandbox.help: 如果为是,任何不在 世界物品移除列表 中的项目将被删除.
sandbox.helpEn: If true, any items *not* in WorldItemRemovalList will be removed.

sandbox.name: TimeSinceApo
sandbox.label: 大灾变后第几个月
sandbox.help:
这将影响开局时的世界腐蚀和食物变质.
默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
How long after the end of the world to begin.
This will affect starting world erosion and food spoilage.
Does not affect the starting date.
Default = 0

sandbox.name: PlantResilience
sandbox.label: 作物适应力
sandbox.help:
会影响植物每天损失多少水分以及它们避免疾病的能力.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How much water plants will lose per day, and their ability to avoid disease.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: PlantAbundance
sandbox.label: 作物产量
sandbox.help:
影响作物收获时的产量.
默认=普通
sandbox.helpEn:
The yield of plants when harvested.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: EndRegen
sandbox.label: 耐力恢复
sandbox.help:
影响体力恢复速度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
Recovery from being tired after performing actions.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: Helicopter
sandbox.label: 直升机
sandbox.help:
直升机在活动区域上空飞过的频率.
默认=一次
sandbox.helpEn:
How regularly a helicopter passes over the Event Zone.
Default = Once

sandbox.name: MetaEvent
sandbox.label: 元事件
sandbox.help:
僵尸吸引元游戏事件的频率有多高,比如远处的枪声.
默认=偶尔
sandbox.helpEn:
How often zombie-attracting metagame events like distant gunshots will occur.
Default = Sometimes

sandbox.name: SleepingEvent
sandbox.label: 睡眠事件
sandbox.help:
控制玩家睡眠期间的夜间元游戏事件.
默认=永不
sandbox.helpEn:
How often events during the player's sleep, like nightmares, occur.
Default = Never

sandbox.name: GeneratorFuelConsumption
sandbox.label: 发电机油耗
sandbox.help:
影响发电机每小时消耗多少燃料.
最小值=0.00 最大值=100.00 默认=0.10
sandbox.helpEn:
How much fuel is consumed by generators per in-game hour.
Min: 0.00 Max: 100.00 Default: 0.10

sandbox.name: GeneratorSpawning
sandbox.label: 发电机生成
sandbox.help:
增加/减少发电机在地图上生成的机会.
默认=经常
sandbox.helpEn:
The chance of electrical generators spawning on the map.
Default = Rare

sandbox.name: AnnotatedMapChance
sandbox.label: 注释地图几率
sandbox.help:
影响一张被搜刮到的地图上有已故幸存者标记注释的频率.
默认=偶尔
sandbox.helpEn:
How often a looted map will have notes on it, written by a deceased survivor.
Default = Sometimes

sandbox.name: CharacterFreePoints
sandbox.label: 自由特征点
sandbox.help:
在角色创建期间追加的自由点数.
最小值=-100 最大值=100 默认=0
sandbox.helpEn:
Adds free points during character creation.
Min: -100 Max: 100 Default: 0

sandbox.name: ConstructionBonusPoints
sandbox.label: 玩家建筑物强度
sandbox.help:
给玩家建造的建筑额外的生命值, 使它们更能抵抗僵尸的伤害.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
Gives player-built constructions extra hit points so they are 
more resistant to zombie damage.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: NightDarkness
sandbox.label: 夜间亮度
sandbox.help:
夜间的光亮度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
The level of ambient lighting at night.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: NightLength
sandbox.label: 夜晚时长
sandbox.help:
夜间至天明的时间.
默认=普通
sandbox.helpEn:
The time from dusk to dawn.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: BoneFracture
sandbox.label: 骨折
sandbox.help: 当幸存者受到撞击,僵尸伤害和跌落的伤害时,启用或禁用断肢.
sandbox.helpEn: If survivors can get broken limbs from impacts, zombie damage, falls etc.

sandbox.name: InjurySeverity
sandbox.label: 损伤严重程度
sandbox.help:
增加和减少伤害对你身体的影响,以及它们的愈合时间.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
The impact that injuries have on your body, and their healing time.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: HoursForCorpseRemoval
sandbox.label: 尸体移除前的时间
sandbox.help:
僵尸尸体移除的游戏时间.
最小值=-1.00 最大值=2147483647.00 默认=216.00
sandbox.helpEn:
How long, in hours, before dead zombie bodies disappear from the world. 
If 0, maggots will not spawn on corpses.
Min: -1.00 Max: 2147483647.00 Default: 216.00

sandbox.name: DecayingCorpseHealthImpact
sandbox.label: 腐烂尸体对健康的影响
sandbox.help:
控制附近腐烂的尸体对玩家健康和情绪的影响.
默认=一般
sandbox.helpEn:
The impact that nearby decaying bodies has on the player's health and emotions.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: ZombieHealthImpact
sandbox.label: 僵尸对玩家影响
sandbox.help: 附近的"活"僵尸是否对玩家的健康和情绪有相同的影响.
sandbox.helpEn: Whether nearby "living" zombies have the same impact on the player's health and emotions.

sandbox.name: BloodLevel
sandbox.label: 血腥等级
sandbox.help:
溅射在 地板/墙壁 上的血量.
默认=一般
sandbox.helpEn:
How much blood is sprayed on floors and walls by injuries.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: ClothingDegradation
sandbox.label: 衣物劣化
sandbox.help:
控制衣物劣化,变脏和血迹斑斑的速度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
How quickly clothing degrades, becomes dirty, and bloodied.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: FireSpread
sandbox.label: 火势蔓延
sandbox.help: 如果火灾开始后会蔓延.
sandbox.helpEn: If fires spread when started.

sandbox.name: DaysForRottenFoodRemoval
sandbox.label: 腐烂食物移除
sandbox.help:
将腐烂的食物从地图上移除之前的游戏天数. 
-1表示永不移除腐烂的食物.
最小值=-1 最大值=2147483647 默认=-1
sandbox.helpEn:
Number of in-game days before rotten food is removed from the map. 
-1 means rotten food is never removed.
Min: -1 Max: 2147483647 Default: -1

sandbox.name: AllowExteriorGenerator
sandbox.label: 发电机在野外工作
sandbox.help:
如果启用,发电机将在野外的地砖上工作, 
例如允许为油泵供电.
sandbox.helpEn:
If enabled, generators will work on exterior tiles. 
This will allow, for example, the powering of gas pumps.

sandbox.name: MaxFogIntensity
sandbox.label: 雾气强度
sandbox.help:
雾气最大强度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
Maximum intensity of fog.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: MaxRainFxIntensity
sandbox.label: 最大降雨特效强度
sandbox.help:
降雨最大强度.
默认=正常
sandbox.helpEn:
Maximum intensity of rain.
Default = Normal

sandbox.name: EnableSnowOnGround
sandbox.label: 启用地面积雪
sandbox.help:
如果禁用, 积雪将不会积聚在地面上, 
但在植被和屋顶上仍然可以看到.
sandbox.helpEn:
If snow will accumulate on the ground. 
If disabled, snow will still show on vegetation and rooftops.

sandbox.name: AttackBlockMovements
sandbox.label: 不可移动攻击
sandbox.help: 若禁用则近战攻击不影响行走.
sandbox.helpEn: If melee attacking slows you down.

sandbox.name: SurvivorHouseChance
sandbox.label: 随机房屋几率
sandbox.help:
增加/降低在地图上发现随机安全屋的概率: 
要么被烧毁, 要么包含战利品, 幸存者尸体等.
默认=稀少
sandbox.helpEn:
The chance of finding randomized buildings on the map (eg. burnt out houses, 
ones containing loot stashes or dead bodies).
Default = Rare

sandbox.name: VehicleStoryChance
sandbox.label: 随机车辆故事发生几率
sandbox.help:
道路事件 (例如, 警察路障) 生成的几率.
默认=稀少
sandbox.helpEn:
The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.
Default = Rare

sandbox.name: ZoneStoryChance
sandbox.label: 随机区域故事发生几率
sandbox.help:
特定地图区域事件 (例如, 森林中的营地) 生成的几率.
默认=稀少
sandbox.helpEn:
The chance of stories specific to map zones (eg. a campsite in a forest) spawning.
Default = Rare

sandbox.name: AllClothesUnlocked
sandbox.label: 服装全解锁
sandbox.help: 允许你在自定义角色时从游戏中的所有服装中选择
sandbox.helpEn: Allows you to select from every piece of clothing in the game when customizing your character

sandbox.name: EnableTaintedWaterText
sandbox.label: 启用 污染的水 提示
sandbox.help: 如果禁用,污染的水将不会有警告标志.
sandbox.helpEn: If tainted water will show a warning marking it as such.

sandbox.name: EnableVehicles
sandbox.label: 启用汽车
sandbox.help: 允许车辆的生成.
sandbox.helpEn: If vehicles will spawn.

sandbox.name: CarSpawnRate
sandbox.label: 车辆生成率
sandbox.help:
地图上发现汽车的频率.
默认=低
sandbox.helpEn:
How frequently vehicles can be discovered on the map.
Default = Low

sandbox.name: ZombieAttractionMultiplier
sandbox.label: 僵尸吸引倍率
sandbox.help:
用此来放大或降低发动机的总体响度.
最小值=0.00 最大值=100.00 默认=1.00
sandbox.helpEn:
General engine loudness to zombies.
Min: 0.00 Max: 100.00 Default: 1.00

sandbox.name: VehicleEasyUse
sandbox.label: 简单模式
sandbox.help: 汽车是否被锁住,是否需要钥匙才能启动等.
sandbox.helpEn: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.

sandbox.name: InitialGas
sandbox.label: 初始油量
sandbox.help:
控制发现的汽车的油箱装满程度.
默认=低
sandbox.helpEn:
How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.
Default = Low

sandbox.name: FuelStationGasInfinite
sandbox.label: 加油站无限燃料
sandbox.help: 如果启用, 加油站将永远不会耗尽燃料
sandbox.helpEn: If enabled, gas pumps will never run out of fuel

sandbox.name: FuelStationGasMin
sandbox.label: 初始加油站最小燃料
sandbox.help:
加油站可以生成的最小燃料量. 
勾选下方的"高级"选项以使用自定义数量.
最小值=0.00 最大值=1.00 默认=0.00
sandbox.helpEn:
The minimum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.
Min: 0.00 Max: 1.00 Default: 0.00

sandbox.name: FuelStationGasMax
sandbox.label: 初始加油站最大燃料
sandbox.help:
加油站可以生成的最大燃料量. 
勾选下方的"高级"选项以使用自定义数量.
最小值=0.00 最大值=1.00 默认=0.80
sandbox.helpEn:
The maximum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.
Min: 0.00 Max: 1.00 Default: 0.80

sandbox.name: FuelStationGasEmptyChance
sandbox.label: 初始加油站空置几率
sandbox.help:
个别加油站最初没有燃料的几率, 以百分比表示.

Min: 0 Max: 1000 Default: 20

sandbox.name: ZombieConfig.RallyGroupSizeVariance

例如, 默认群组大小为 20, 变异为 50% 时, 群组大小将在 10-30 之间变化.
最小值=0 最大值=100 默认=50
sandbox.helpEn:
The amount, as a percentage, that zombie groups can vary in size from the default (both larger and smaller). 
 For example, at 50% variance with a default group size of 20, groups will vary in size from 10-30.

sandbox.name: ZombieConfig.ZombiesCountBeforeDelete

控制清理前系统追踪的僵尸最大数量. 0代表不会自动清理僵尸.
强烈推荐使用默认值 300. 调高该数值或设为 0 可能引发严重性能问题.
如需排查故障或提交 bug 反馈, 请先使用默认参数复现问题后再提交报告.

sandbox.helpEn:
Controls the maximum number of zombies tracked before cleanup occurs. 0 means zombies will not be cleaned up.
The default value (300) is strongly recommended. Increasing this value or setting to 0 may cause severe performance problems.
For troubleshooting and bug-report purposes, please reproduce any issue with the default setting before submitting a report.
Min: 0 Max: 5000 Default: 300
